target_customer: US consumers splitting bills or sending small sums by SMS
problem: Sending small amounts of money to friends, such as splitting a restaurant bill, was awkward.
business_model: Free during beta, planned fees on SMS payments, monthly cap of 500 dollars

founders.name: Philip Yuen
founders.background_notes: Per Wired 2006. YC page lists him as founder.

competitors.name: PayPal Mobile
competitors.what: SMS payments from registered PayPal accounts

competitors.name: Obopay
competitors.what: Phone app plus SMS payments with a debit card

technical_complexity.rationale: SMS gateway (shared MX Telecom with PayPal Mobile) plus bank funding and PIN confirmation, mostly integration work.

defensibility.rationale: PayPal launched a near identical SMS payment product in April 2006.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: PayPal Mobile launched in 2006, and the team joined Amazon in July 2006 per YC page; the service later redirected to Amazon Payments.

market_need_then: Press in 2006 pitched it as eliminating the IOU between friends, and PayPal and Obopay both entered the same year, though Failory notes US peer to peer payments had not yet taken off.

branding.domain_note: textpayme.com redirected to Amazon Payments after the acquisition (observed at fetch time).

brand_strength.rationale: Covered by Wired, CNN Money and blogs in 2006 as the next PayPal, but no evidence of a lasting brand.

outcome_analysis: TextPayMe launched its SMS payment beta in December 2005, got early press, and within months faced PayPal Mobile and Obopay. The team started working at Amazon in July 2006 and the site later redirected to Amazon Payments, which looks like a soft landing rather than a venture exit. No press release or price was found.
notes: Acquisition date conflicts (YC says team started at Amazon July 2006, a Wikipedia derived list says 2006-10-01 with 3M, CB Insights says 2007-10); the 3M figure is unverified. YC says acquisition is assumed, as no press release exists. YC founder bio says YC 06 while batch is Summer 2005. Seed from YC listed by aggregators with no amount. Company site only observed as a redirect to Amazon; not an original site. Completeness pass: the YC seed rests on Seedtable (2005-12, no amount); CB Insights dates it 2006-01-17. No dollar amount found anywhere.
